From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@nebulainc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo — forwarded invite stripped join URL (tracked)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for scheduling the demo for tomorrow at 11am PT. I just got a note from support that one of your teammates (Jill) forwarded the Google invite to an external vendor and the forwarded ICS appears to have been stripped of the join metadata during forwarding. The result: the "Join with Google Meet" button is missing for some guests and GCal shows a blank join URL.

Can you confirm whether Jill forwarded the native invite or forwarded an extracted .ics file? I attached the file you sent over (forwarded-invite.ics) — looks like organizer= field is empty and X-ALT-JOIN is gone.

Short-term workaround I'm proposing: we resend a one-off Zoom meeting link (temporary) and do a quick "Zoom handshake" so no guests are blocked. Long-term we can reissue a cleaned ICS with organizer claim so your calendar renders the join button correctly.

Proposed temporary Zoom (will create and share if you confirm):
- Wednesday 11:00 AM PT — Zoom link handshake and we host from Redwood (we can transfer host after)

Please let me know if you want us to post the Zoom link now and reissue the ICS after the handshake.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov

Quick workaround from ops side —

1) We create a temporary Zoom meeting and post the link into the thread (handshake). Everyone joins via Zoom and we mark the RDW-side host as the organizer so the acceptance flows are fine. After the meeting start we can transfer host to a Nebula attendee if needed.
2) Simultaneously we'll reissue a cleaned ICS with organizer claim set to olga@redwood.com and the X-ALT-JOIN header present. That should restore the Meet join button for guests who rely on calendar buttons.

Steps I'll take now if you approve (Olga):
- Spin up Zoom meeting and generate passcode-enabled link.
- Reissue ICS and push to Samir/Jill; include instructions to "replace" the corrupted event rather than creating a duplicate.
- If Nebula wants, we can also send the invite from a shared@redwood account to avoid delegate aliasing problems.

Time: 11:00 AM PT tomorrow (same slot)
